name: aizalo-mcp
description: Zalo-Flow Model Context Protocol (MCP) Server for personal Zalo automation, AI agent messaging, and CRM tagging.

transport.notes: Runs locally alongside Zalo-Flow Desktop Client

tools.name: zalo_send_message
tools.description: Send a text message or response to a Zalo conversation thread.

tools.name: zalo_lookup_phone
tools.description: Search and retrieve a Zalo user profile by Vietnamese phone number.

tools.name: zalo_add_reaction
tools.description: Add an emoji reaction to a Zalo message.

tools.name: campaign_send_broadcast
tools.description: Send remarketing broadcast campaign to contacts filtered by CRM tag.

tools.name: system_get_bot_status
tools.description: Get current connection status and health of the Zalo client.
